card.name: First word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word of text right after a numbered section heading in a drug label, such as Contraindications or Warnings. Often a sentence opener like Because, This, Second or In.

modes.label: Sentence opener after heading
modes.description: A starter word like Because, Second or This directly follows a section title.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS<< Because>> of the hydrochlorothiazide component

modes.label: Split first word
modes.description: The first piece of a drug or ordinary word that begins right after a heading.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS<< Los>>artan potassium tablets are contraind
